main_prompt: FIXED_SUBAGENT_PARENT_PROMPT: Use the Agent tool once to run a general-purpose subagent that returns a short fixed result. After the subagent finishes, report the result.
main_response_text: FIXED_SUBAGENT_PARENT_RESPONSE: parent completed after receiving the child result.
